items.title: Cybersecurity firm unveils crypto phishing campaign targeting 885,000 phone numbers
items.summary: Rapid7 unveiled a new cryptocurrency phishing campaign targeting 885,000 phone numbers, aiming to steal investors’ holdings by redirecting them to fake wallet provider websites.

items.title: Optimism-funded team's deciding vote shifts $49 million in OP tokens away from users
items.summary: The approved plan reallocates 546.9 million OP from user airdrops to a Foundation-controlled Strategic Ecosystem Fund.

items.title: Ripple-linked XRP jumps 15% as data shows 'banker hours' onchain pattern
items.summary: Three hours spanning the London afternoon and New York morning account for about 23% of XRP moving onchain, up from roughly 14% a year ago.

items.title: OpenLedger’s Ram Kumar sees agentic payments as crypto’s first AI ‘killer app’
items.summary: OpenLedger core contributor Ram Kumar sees agentic payments as a major crypto use case as AI agents lack traditional banking access.
